title: Tribes value under block conditions
statement: Let $w,s$ be natural numbers, let $i$ be a coordinate in the sign cube of dimension $sw$, and let $x$ be an element of that cube. If every coordinate in the block containing $i$, other than $i$, has sign $-1$, and every other block has AND value $+1$, then the tribes function on $x$ equals the AND value of the block containing $i$.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ is a sign vector of dimension $sw$
All coordinates in the block of $i$ except $i$ have sign $-1$
Every block other than the block of $i$ has AND value $+1$
